title: Tomodachi Life
shortDescription: Tomodachi Life helps define a Nintendo 3DS family simulation path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Brings a source-aware simulation entry to the Nintendo 3DS family browsing route.
Labels the source relationship without treating it as a popularity signal.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Logged for the Nintendo 3DS family simulation discovery path using a direct Wikidata structured-data record; this remains a catalog record, never an aggregate score.
